FN-YDX9N6-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 168
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Kerry (Bubba)
Underwood
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/09/2023
House Bill 168 as introduced would increase: (1) the competitive bidding floor for certain local
and education agencies from $15,000, under current law, to $30,000; (2) the competitive
bidding floor for public works contracts from $50,000, under law, to $100,000; and (3) as well
as increasing other threshold dollar amounts for which competitive bidding is required. In
addition, this bill would authorize those dollar amounts to be further increased based on
increases in Consumer Price Index. This bill could increase or decrease the purchase price of
goods and services procured by these entities, depending on the difference in (1) the cost of
products procured under the provisions of this bill and (2) the cost otherwise obtained under
current law.

FN-YDX9N6-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 168
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Kerry (Bubba)
Underwood
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/10/2023
House Bill 168 as reported by the Committee on State Government would: (1) increase the
competitive bidding floor for public works contracts from $50,000, under law, to $100,000; (2)
exclude purchases of heating and air conditioning unit made through State Purchasing Division
of the Department of Finance; (3) provide further for certain emergency purchases; and (4)
allow certain materials and equipment, currently exempt from competitive bidding, but part of a
public works contract, to be excluded from public works bidding requirements. These
provisions could increase or decrease the purchase price of goods and services procured by these
government awarding authority, dependent on the difference in (1) the cost of products procured
under the provisions of this bill and (2) the cost otherwise obtained under current law.
This bill would also: (1) provide further for notice of completion of contracts by contractors; (2)
remove newspaper advertisement requirements for certain public works contracts; and (3) allow
bids for public works contracts to be submitted by electronic means.

increase or decrease the purchase price of goods and services procured by these government

This bill would also: (1) provide further for notice of completion of contracts by contractors; (2)
